*But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the Lord your God.*

Now, contrast the offer of peace we should make with the average men of this world, the unregenerate, or even the saved who have conflict with us, loving our enemies, showing mercy that we may make a brother of them... contrast that with how God commands the Israelites to deal with the nations of Canaan that have become abominations. Who are reprobates. The dogs. The swine. The idolators, passing their children through the fire. God proclaims that nothing that draws breath among them shall be spared. That the Hebrews should slay every last one of them, that they teach them not to do after their abominations. That they don't corrupt the people of God with their filth and unrighteousness.

Of course, today we do not have the power in this world to slay the reprobates among us. Our government has rescinded the laws against the sodomites, for example. It hardly even punishes the rapists and pedophiles among us. But this is instruction that we may take spiritually, and draw lessons from, even as we speak out to bring the magistrates back to executing God's law.

There are some people who are beyond saving. There are some people whom God has given up on. They have been given over to a reprobate mind, rejected of God. And to recognize them, God's word has given us multiple examples of how to know them, the primary one being their burning with lust one towards another, men with men, women with women. Who have left the natural use, to engage in unnatural lusts.

**Romans 1, Hebrews 6, 2 Peter 2, and Jude** provide us with warnings and what to look for. Jesus taught against the false teachers and against giving that which is holy to the dogs. Pearls before swine.

This is controversial today, but it is the whole word of God. We are to mark and avoid, as much as possible, those we can know are reprobate. Not in wrath. Not railing. But to cut them out of our lives as much as possible, and definitely out of our congregations.

**Romans 12:18** should be our default behavior when dealing with others;
*If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.* But we should never declare peace with reprobates, and invite them in, least they teach us, or our children, their abominations.

teachings.title: Israel a reprobate nation
teachings.summary: From Hosea 4 he teaches that Israel, not wishing to retain God in its knowledge, was given over as a reprobate nation to be consumed by its sins, the same judgment coming on the world.
teachings.text:
Continuing the preaching against Israel, its people are wicked, especially even their priests, those low men that were established by Jeroboam, when he introduced idolatry to the people and caused all Israel to sin.

Hosea preaches hard against their sins; the violence and bloodshed, the drunkenness, the literal whoredoms and adultery, and spiritual; chasing after false gods.

The Lord says that if they don't wish to retain Him in their knowledge, they will perish for that lack of knowledge. If the priests won't reprove and rebuke sin, then they are in common cause with it. Let their sins consume them. God won't even scourge them for backsliding. They've been given up and given over, a reprobate nation.

They go to the stocks for advice, that is to wooden idols, sacrifices in groves, seeking favor of their dead gods. So the living God says let their daughters and wives go whoring as they have to Him.

What a wicked time, and the destruction of Israel was long past due. Only the longsuffering love of the Lord stayed their end.

The Lord does make provision to keep the evil out of Judah, that the false religion and fornications of the North, the Idolatry of Ephraim, would not spread into the Southern Kingdom, for now.

What a condemnation. And it is the same righteous judgement of God that will be passed on to the world, even as Judah, or that is saved Christians today, are spared. It may seem like the wicked prosper and go unpunished, but as we see here, that is a punishment in itself. Allowing the blood to heap against them, their own sins to make them miserable, even as they compound. And then, destruction.

Perfect is the judgment of God

teachings.title: Statutes that were not good
teachings.summary: In Ezekiel 20 God gave idolatrous Israel and Judah over to strong delusion and statutes that were not good, as Romans 1 describes, while still pleading with their hardened hearts and promising the kingdom to come.
teachings.text:
This cycle continued, and in Judah as well. *Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live*.

He gave them over to strong delusion, that they may believe a lie. He allowed them to see what happens when they trusted their own foolish hearts that were darkened.

**Romans 1:21-25**
*Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened. Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools, And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things. Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.*

They went to the high places, Bamah in Hebrew, instead of the mount of the Lord, the Temple of Zion in Jerusalem. They worshiped idols in His name and offered sacrifice to them, and ultimately passed their own sons through the fire to Baal. Even those that sat down to enquire of the Lord this day.

*Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?*

God pleads with them as He did with their fathers, that His word against them would prick them in their hardened hearts. That they turn from the sins of their father to embrace the truth of the Lord God.

To that end, He says He will put them to the rod. And destruction and desolation. That He will purge the unrighteous from among them. But if they repented not, so be it. The Lord asks one thing of them, stop doing their gifts and offerings and abominations to their idols in HIS holy name.

*For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.*

This isn't only the restoration of Jerusalem after the captivity. But a prophecy of what would come.

This is the Kingdom of Heaven. This is the holy reign of Christ. This is the final assembly of believers, who will be sanctified before the heathen for His holy name, Jesus. And we shall know that He is the Lord.

teachings.title: Abusers of themselves and the reprobate doctrine
teachings.summary: He argues that modern translations twist 1 Corinthians 6:9-11 into sodomites being saved, which contradicts Romans 1 and the reprobate doctrine, and that the phrase more likely means other fornication such as prostitution or masturbation.
teachings.text:
There's some bad doctrine and controversy regarding these verses and especially surrounding "abusers of themselves with mankind."

Some of the modern translations that so badly butcher the word, make the phrase into being a Sodomite, or specifically the bottom in a queer relationship. They then extrapolate out that "such were some of you" to arrive at the doctrine that f@gg0ts can get saved.

Never mind the context. Never mind this passage isn't regarding salvation but judgment. Never mind that the phrase being translated only appears twice in scripture, and no where else in any form to draw that conclusion. And nevermind that it directly contradicts Romans 1 and other scripture on sodomites and the reprobate doctrine.

Its actual meaning can be debated, but it certainly isn't that.

Most non-pozzed interpret it from context clues of its second appearance in **1 Timothy 1:8-10**:

*8 But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;*

*9 Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,*

*10 For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine*

...where the same phrase is translated as "defile themselves with mankind," rather than "abuse," but the same meaning is intended. They take its proximity to whoremonger to say it indicates being a prostitute.

There is a school of thought, long out of favor, that it means masturbation. Self-abuse being a common term for the act back in the day.

I lean towards this, but it's difficult to say.

The larger context of chapter 6 here, that our bodies are a temple of God, and that fornication is a sin against our own body, hints that it could be any manner of fornication, including prostitution and masturbating.

"But muh effeminate!" Effeminate does not automatically mean being a queer. It means not being manly, carrying yourself as a woman would. Metrosexual f@gg0try.

People will say anything to be rid of the reprobate doctrine and get Sodomites into their church to molest the kids!

teachings.title: The reprobate Sodomites of Genesis 19
teachings.summary: The Sodomites who sought to rape the angels were reprobates given over by God to unnatural lusts and all unrighteousness after freely rejecting Him, as Romans 1 and Pharaoh's example show, unlike the common sins of ordinary men.
teachings.text:
Now, as for the reprobate Sodomites, who both old and young, the Bible says, see that the angels of the Lord, in human form, have come to Sodom, and seek to rape them, surrounding Lot's home demanding he produce them that they may "know" them.

Lot begs them not to, and even offers his virgin daughters to the men rather than give up those in his care.

(This is a similar story to the one told in **Judges 19**, showing again where the wickedness of man can lead.)

We know from scripture that while man's heart is wicked, and left to our own devices, living in the flesh that all manner of natural sin afflicts us if we don't walk in the spirit, daily. If we don't feed our new man, as Paul calls it, but rather live carnally giving in to the old man. And for the unbelieving, this is doubly true. All forms of evil we can get up to. Lust, envyings, lying, fearfulness, adultery, fornication, whoremongering, harlotry, drunkenness, stealing, wrath and railing, greed and vengeance. Profaning what's holy, even blaspheming God or Jesus' name.

Sins all too common to man. We are all sinners, of which I am chief.

And these sins have their reward. The wages of sin is death. And for the saved, the chastisement from God in this life, and a loss of rewards and blessings in this life and the next. Even being taken home to the Lord early, being so lost in sin despite our being saved. Many such cases.

But the reprobate, those who the Bible says have been rejected by God. Disapproved, given up, given over. They are given over to a reprobate mind to do those things which are inconvenient. Who burn with unnatural lusts and are filled with **all unrighteousness**, as the Bible says in **Romans 1**:

*Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.*

*For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:*
*And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.*

*And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient; Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers, Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents, Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.*

Reprobates have chosen to reject God to the point they are past saving, and God gives them what they want, and in doing so they are now without conscience, and the wickedness of their hearts turns to even unnatural things.

So many people struggle with this doctrine. Even when shown the examples throughout the Bible, and knowing the judgment of God of what they are, how they came to be, what they do, and what they deserve, people still refuse to see it.

We are given the process, the order of operations as it were, that reprobation like salvation is a free will choice. That God provides chances to accept the truth, and they reject it.

In [Exodus 7](https://t.me/HouseOfWews2/254) we are shown the process, as we see Pharoah given multiple chances and he hardens his heart to the truth, until God gives him up, gives him over, and hardens his heart Himself.

Jude described them "*These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots."*

teachings.title: Sodomy as the outward sign of the reprobate mind
teachings.summary: Men are rejected by choice rather than blood or sin, and open, proud sodomy is the clearest outward sign of the reprobate mind, so there are no repentant sodomites, though not every reprobate is a sodomite.
teachings.text:
And so, understanding that these are rejected by God not of blood, or DNA, not by their sin (altho there are unpardonable sins; blasphemy of the holy Spirit; altering God's word, taking the mark of the beast in that time), but by choice. They choose not to retain the law of God written in all man's hearts, not wishing to retain the knowledge of the truth that all men know. Again in **Romans 1**;

*Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them. For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse.*

And so without excuse, they choose. And therefore, as a consequence, they are given up to vile affections. And one of the most outward signs of the reprobate mind is becoming a sodomite. Having pride in their unnatural lusts. Making their abomination their identity. Who, knowing that what they do by the judgment of God is deserving of death, their blood be upon them, they do it anyway. And take pleasure in those who do these things also.

Now not every reprobate is a sodomite. There are some who, despite being psychopaths, and filled with all unrighteousness, choose to not engage in sodomy. They are malignant and damned, and have the potential to do these unnatural abominations, but may have restraint by fear of being caught and punished by the law, by opportunity, or whatever else restrains these conscience seared dogs from acting out the evil inside them. Those wolves in sheep's clothing can be recognized by other means, but some are great at hiding it.

But ALL who are open and proud sodomites are without any doubt, haters of God and twice-dead. Easily recognizable. The judgment of God reveals them to us.

There are no "repentant sodomites." There's none who, once given over and given up, come to the knowledge of the truth.

They may lie and say they have. They may even appear to "clean up their lives," and, shamefully, some may even appear to man as more righteous than a backslidden saved son of God. But they themselves remain sons of Belial.

teachings.title: Spiritual blindness like the men of Sodom
teachings.summary: He teaches that reprobates with seared consciences prey on children as the men of Sodom did, and that as Sodom's men were struck blind God gives reprobates spiritual blindness so they cannot see the truth they rejected.
teachings.text:
Paul writing to Timothy says "*Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron*."

Jesus calls these reprobates "dogs," "vipers" and suggests they would be better off killing themselves than allowing their evil to corrupt a child. They always go for the children. Note in Sodom it was the old *and* young surrounding Lot's house.

And like the men and boys of Sodom, struck blind that the angels may protect Lot, God gives reprobates a spiritual blindness that they may not see the truth they'd so utterly rejected.

As Jesus teaches in **John 12:39-40**:

*Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again, He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.*

teachings.title: Satan's Seed Is Spiritual
teachings.summary: The seed of Satan is not physical descent from Eve but spiritual: those who do his lusts and multiply by recruiting, grooming and perversion.
teachings.text:
I don't believe the "Satan's Seed" theory, that some of mankind are literally descended from Satan raping Eve in the Garden. It's wicked and perverse and unbiblical.

But Satan does have a seed, and it is spiritual. It is those who do his bidding and have his lusts. Filled with all unrighteousness. Inventors of evil, who propagate not by the miracle of life, given by God to Adam and Eve, but by trauma and abuse, grooming and temptation. Subversion and perversions.

They don't reproduce they recruit.

*Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.*

And unlike God who loves the world enough to offer His only begotten Son that whoever believes on Him shall not perish but have everlasting life, the Devil hates mankind. Even his own children, and our destruction and death are all he desires.

A murderer from the beginning, knowing that by casting doubt on God's word, and getting Eve and Adam to eat of the fruit, they would surely die.

teachings.title: Millstone warning to reprobate pedophiles
teachings.summary: From Luke 17 he teaches that reprobate sodomites recruit by offending children and that Jesus tells them they would be better drowned, then applies the warning against offending others to believers too.
teachings.text:
Luke 17 continues the portion of the Gospel where Jesus preaches and teaches, making His way to Jerusalem. Here, again addressing His disciples Jesus says "*It is impossible but that offenses will come."*

Understand that in the Bible, "offenses" refers to causing another to sin. To place a stumbling block in another's path, giving them occasion to sin. Jesus says it is impossible but that we be offended. That there will be stumbling blocks and snares and temptations brought before all men, including we who are saved. It is inevitable. "*But woe unto him, through whom they come!"*

Jesus says woe unto the person offending, the person laying snares and stumbling blocks. The person tempting another to sin. Woe unto them, that it would be *better that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea than that he should offend one of these little ones*, speaking of the children brought before Him, as we see in the other Gospels.

We tend to understand and focus on the direct application of this teaching, regarding sodomites who target and corrupt children, grooming them with abuse, guile, alcohol, corrupt speech, into becoming a reprobate like themselves. That they don't reproduce, they recruit and do so by offending little ones.

It is a correct teaching to say that Jesus is telling these reprobate pedophiles that they should kill themselves to make it easier on them in Hell, for the added torment they will receive for offending against a child. It is true. The false idea that the Jesus of the NT is some hippy dippy "all is love" God, somehow different from the God of the Old Testament isn't supported by scripture. He comes in wrath on the day of the Lord, and all in Hell are tormented before His presence.

I feel like the high incidents of suicide in the sodomite community comes from this basic understanding that they are escaping even worse punishment than the eternity in outer darkness, burning in a lake of fire, that they already face. Heeding Jesus' warning.

But there is a broader application to this doctrine, one few of us are willing to apply to ourselves. How often have we in our lives brought offense to another? Even if it were intentionally making someone else angry and wrathful?

It doesn't have to be tempting someone to share our sin. Getting them to drink booze, smoke cigarettes, fornication, to steal. It can be as basic as spinning up fear in their lives by promoting that which you know triggers their outrage, and pushes the buttons that lead them to spiral into fear, and wrath. We have a responsibility not to be a stumbling block for others. Jesus' warning is to us, too.

In all matters, we are to seek the spiritual profit of others. It doesn't do that to aggressively red pill or black pill someone weaker in the faith than you. To "truth-rape" a normie. To put the cares of this world before that of the Kingdom to come. This isn't to say we don't speak the truth, stand for Biblical principles, provide guidance and knowledge that others may better navigate the world and grow in faith. But it does mean we don't try to offend, in the biblical sense of the word. Don't seek to trip someone up to an occasion to sin.

And especially don't bring sin to a child, you should rather join the pedophiles at the bottom of the sea.

teachings.title: Homosexuality a curse of reprobation
teachings.summary: From Leviticus 18 he teaches that homosexuality is an abomination and an outward sign of being given over to a reprobate mind, the wrath of God revealed.
teachings.text:
*Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.*

Homosexuality is, and always has been, an abomination to God. It is a curse of reprobation. It is an outward sign of having been given up and given over to a reprobate mind. It is the wrath of God revealed against those who hold the truth in unrighteousness.

*Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.*

Beastiality is another abomination. It is disgusting and likely more common than we consider, especially in less developed countries, or in earlier times. But as we have seen in our own news reports, it happens even here. More so perhaps.

teachings.title: Judas was a devil, never saved
teachings.summary: Judas does not show salvation can be lost, because Jesus knew from the beginning he believed not and called him a devil.
teachings.text:
*But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him*

There is a false doctrine out there that Judas proves you can lose your salvation, but of course that's untrue. Not only wasn't Judas saved, he was a reprobate and Jesus knew this. I've had people say to me "What? Did Jesus make a mistake choosing Judas? Clearly Judas believed and then rejected Christ and lost his salvation." But they speak in ignorance because they do not know the scriptures.

*Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil? He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.*

This literally couldn't be any clearer and is completely spelled out, And yet when showing this verse to people who deny once saved always saved, they cannot, and I mean this as a supernatural phenomenon of having their mind darkened in their eyes blinded, they **cannot** see this.

teachings.title: O foolish Galatians
teachings.summary: Those who add law, repentance from sin, rites or traditions to the gospel are foolish Galatians, and most of Christendom does so and is given over to blindness so they cannot see faith alone in plain scripture.
teachings.text:
O foolish Galatians! Here, a picture of those adding works to the salvation of faith, the Galatians represent many calling themselves Christian today. Those adding works of the law, repentance from sin, rites and rituals, vain traditions of men, foolish genealogies and every other thing to the simple Gospel of Christ Jesus crucified. Allowing others to preach a false gospel to them, and by foolishly accepting it among them, make whatever travails they have in Jesus name, received in vain.

Understand that those called by His name will be persecuted the same whether they believe the Gospel or not. Whether they are justified by the blood or perishing under the law. And the works that they do for righteousness earn them nothing. No rewards because they will burn up with them in their sin, accursed by their faith in themselves under the law.

Paul asks have they, having begun in the Spirit, by hearing the word, think they can be made complete and righteous enough for heaven by their flesh? It's foolishness.

99% of Christianity today believe this foolish thing, and damn themselves in their foolishness. And preferring their foolishness to the wisdom of God, God gives them their delusion, with spiritual blindness that makes them, when reading passages like Galatians 2 and 3, with plain hard language telling them the salvation is by faith alone, unable to see it. They cannot hear it. They cannot believe the report.

teachings.title: Ordain elders and stop the mouths of deceivers
teachings.summary: Titus 1 gives the qualifications for elders who hold fast sound doctrine to convince gainsayers, especially reprobate Judaizers whose fables led to the Roman Catholic Church.
teachings.text:
This epistle, written to Titus, Paul's son in the faith, who the Apostle had left in Crete to evangelize, just as he had Timothy in Ephesus.

And just as he did in his letters to Timothy, Paul lays the foundation for the office of bishop, or pastor in today's parlance, a shepherd of the flock, and deacons or elders, those who work in a church ministering, serving the flock and aiding their shepherd.

 Commanding Titus to *ordain elders in every city,* the criteria being; *blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.* Because, as the steward of God, the man handling the affairs and overseeing His sheep, must have these qualities; *not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre; But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate.*

Not given to wine and sober not being repetitive notions, but sober in scripture meaning not only clear-headed but serious as well. Matured in their attitudes. Not angry and wrathful and violent. Not a lover of money, corrupt, chasing after filthy lucre. A lover of hospitality and good men. *Just, holy and temperate*.

This is the model for all seeking the offices of pastor or deacon, and should be what is given as an example for all young men of the faith to strive towards. Not only those who "feel a calling," but those who in humility and meekness seek to be right with God, that they may be blameless and able to win souls to the Lord.

*Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.*

This should be the goal of all those who know Christ. Studying to be approved by God, and able to have a ready answer to those who seek truth, or who having hardened their hearts, seek to subvert it.

And why is this so important to establish, especially with elders in the churches? Paul tells us, again warning as he has repeatedly, of those reprobate concerning the faith.

*For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.*

Even in Paul's day, even in that first century, not far removed from Jesus'resurrection and ascension, even as Apostles and disciples blessed with the gifts of the Holy Ghost spread the word, preaching to every creature throughout the world, there were *many* false prophets. Vain talkers. Especially of the circumcision. Jews who being reprobate by God sought to subvert the nascent Christian communities with deceit, just as they do today.

Paul gives an example of one such viper, who insulting the Cretians sought to keep them from the faith, and exhorts Titus to openly rebuke. To teach sound doctrines that the Cretian believers not be led astray, *giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.*

Judaizers who attacked the word of God and His churches then, never gave up, even forming their own religions based on Jewish fables, the apocryphal books and forgeries prevalent at the time. Doing it for filthy lucre's sake. For money, power, prestige. Control of others. Leaning on their own understanding, denying the power of scripture. Following after vain traditions and the commandments of men. Dead works, denying the power of the Gospel and faith unto salvation.

This is the origin of the Roman Catholic Church, and the source of her harlot daughters, subverting whole houses. Who *compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than* themselves, as Jesus said of the same Judaizers who murdered Him.

Who could do such things? What kind of man could be so contrary to all other men, that they'd seek to subvert and damn others, as they are? Just as their father, the devil seeks to? Reprobates. Conscience seared, defiled, twice-dead. Deserving death.

teachings.title: The Key of David Opens and Shuts
teachings.summary: Christ opens the door of salvation that none can shut and also shuts in reprobation, and those who say they are Jews but deny Christ are liars, spiritually Edom.
teachings.text:
*And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;*

Jesus addresses the church at Philadelphia. Jesus is holy and true. He has the key of David, mentioned in **Isaiah 22:22**:

*And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.*

To Him gave all the prophets witness.

Also, don't miss this, Jesus opens the door of salvation to us as individual believers, and none may shut it. We have eternal life. It can't be lost or taken. But Christ Jesus also has the ability to shut the door, that none may open. This is reprobation, and it's a doctrine found throughout the Bible. Many find it difficult to accept or believe, but it is taught throughout scripture, clearly and with examples. Sadly today, many are offended at the concept.

Jesus continues, praising them for their faith. Promising He's opened the door for them. Man has little strength. We cannot open that door ourselves, only His may.

*I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name. Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.*

The church in Philadelphia is being persecuted, like some of the others, and again it is the Jews. Jesus says they say they are Jews but are not. That they are liars.

There are theories and interpretations as to what this means. Edomites? The Ashkenazi? Khazarians? These are earthly interpretations, with physical/genetic/ethnic implications. And they may very well be a marker that has some application. But what we know for certain, spiritually, that they who say they are Jews but are not, are spiritually Edom indeed. They are Esau, who sold their birthright, which has been taken by the Gentiles who are spiritually Jacob.

**Romans 2:28-29**
*For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.*

For us, it is sufficient to understand that those who reject the Son have not the Father. That those who deny Jesus is the Christ are liars, and antichrists. By focusing on the spiritual application, it becomes inarguable that they who say they are Jews are not, but are liars. Without going down rabbi holes arguing about their origins and debates about genealogies. The word of God is sharper than any arguments of man, and discerns quickly exactly why they are not Jews; for if they kept the law of Moses and believed the prophets, they would believe Jesus is who He says He is. That He is the Christ.

But we who are spiritually His, who are inwardly circumcised of the heart, we can take solace in our tribulations caused by the wicked Jew antichrists, that they are a synagogue of Satan and Jesus will make them worship at His feet and know that He loves us, His brothers and sisters who believed on His name. Who trusted God's word.

Every knee shall bow and every tongue confess. Amen!

Continuing to the Philadelphians;
*Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth. Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.*

Jesus encourages them. They are doing well. Holdfast. Faint not. And as the temptation, the test of the deceiver, comes upon the world, they who remain patient and true will be protected from the deception. Note that Jesus encourages them to maintain their works and faith that they not lose crowns. Crowns are rewards in Heaven given to believers based on our works.

teachings.title: Still They Repented Not
teachings.summary: Even in His wrath God seeks repentance, yet hardened men refuse, and believers should study the timing themselves rather than lean on others.
teachings.text:
The Bible tells us that *The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.*

Even in His wrath and judgment upon the Earth, He seeks repentance of those being afflicted for their wicked hearts. And as we see in Revelation 9, despite the supernatural destruction, the signs and wonders in Heaven, the resurrection of the dead and gathering in the clouds of the elect, the woes and all, the men of the earth will still refuse. Stiff-necked and hearts hardened.

Some folks you just can't reach.

We will see in the following chapter the two witnesses appear in all this, and call the people to repentance preaching in His name. I believe the 144,000 likely are sent to minister the Gospel to those few on Earth who do repent during this time, the three and a half years of wrath before the millennial reign begins.

Of the timing; we know the day of the Lord begins the trumpet judgments. The initial destruction and fire and hail happening quickly. But the 5th trump, the first woe, lasts on earth 5 months (the remaining months of the 4th year, the day of the Lord coming slightly more than 3 and a half years into the Great Tribulation)

Then the armies of God come against man for a year and a month and a day and an hour.

I admit the granular indexing of the exact days and weeks, reflected in Daniels 70 Weeks prophecy from **Daniel 9** can make my eyes glaze over. But people more autistic than I have charted it out and found the days and years matching up with Revelation, and the events foretold. While it is fascinating to consider and a testament to the awesome precision of God's word, I won't get out over my skis trying to explain it. But we can see from these verses there is a timing of things. A way to know when and how long each thing happens.

One of the ways false doctrines evolve surrounding these events is that many are like me, and daunted by some of the more seemingly esoteric aspects, and so they lean heavily on other's interpretation, rather than studying it out themselves.

So make the effort to read and compare scripture with scripture yourself, even if you only get the gist of the timing. Because God reveals it openly. Do not be deceived.

teachings.title: The Woman's Seed and the Serpent's Seed
teachings.summary: Revelation 12 fulfils Genesis 3: Eve's seed is Christ who crushes Satan, while Satan's seed are the reprobate who persecute those who overcome by the blood.
teachings.text:
Moving to the second half of Revelation, we take a step back, and in the more symbolic vision of John, we have what is essentially the fulfilment of the Genesis 3 prophecy, Eve, the mother of man, bringing forth her seed, even Jesus Christ, the Son of man.

The enmity of the serpent and the woman, his seed and her own. She bringing forth the man child who will crush Satan's head, he seeking to devour Him as soon as He was born.

The seed of Eve is man, and through her, Jesus. The seed of Satan are his spawn, reprobates. Sons of Belial. Twice-dead dogs. Vipers.

*Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.*

And so Satan tempts the earth and brings against all man tribulation. Going before the throne of God accusing man night and day. And knowing the Christ was born, sought to destroy Him through Herod, killing all the male children.

Ultimately, by the Jews who were Satan's seed, bruising the heel of Jesus, in death, only to see Jesus rise triumphant, overcoming the world with the keys to Hell and Death. And those sons of men who held the testimony of Jesus overcame through the blood of the Lamb.

And so it has been, Satan accusing and tempting the world, he and his wicked seed persecuting those who have overcome by the blood of Christ, and destroying mankind at every opportunity, like a ravenous lion.

But, as the end comes he will be cast out by Michael and his angels, and will be loosed on the earth for a short time to do his worst. This is the Great Tribulation, and for a 3 and a half year period, making war on the saints and overcoming them. But they who love not their lives unto death shall be saved....

teachings.title: The Vials Align with the Trumpets
teachings.summary: The seven vials parallel the seven trumpets in the same wrath period, poured on the damned who harden their hearts rather than repent.
teachings.text:
The 7 vial judgments of the Lord. His wrath and recompense for sin. As all who remain on the earth either worshiped the beast and took the mark, damning themselves or remained unsaved up unto the end of Great Tribulation and the rapture, they and the earth itself suffer the righteous anger and just judgment of the Lord. It is fitting punishment that the saints in Heaven had prayed for, giving glory to the Lord for His wrath has come.

These 7 vials align with the 7 trumpet judgments of chapters 8-11.

Trumpet 1, Vial 1
Trumpet 2, Vial 2
Trumpet 3, Vial 3
Trumpet 4, Vial 4
Trumpet 5, Vial 5
Trumpet 6, Vial 6
Trumpet 7, Vial 7

And are poured out in the same three and a half year period, the second half of Daniel's 70 Weeks. And as we can compare, many of the vials match or enhance the trumpet judgments. There is overlap to the destruction John witnesses and describes.

The first trumpet brings fire to the earth and burns up a third of the trees and all green grass. The vial brings grievous sores upon those with the mark. A judgment of the earth and of man.

The 2nd trump, a mountain burning with fire is cast into the sea, turning a 3rd of the oceans to blood, killing sea life and destroying a third of ships. The 2nd vial, the seas all become blood and all life therein dies. The stink of putrid fish and rancid blood overwhelming the earth.

The third trump and vial; the rivers and fountains of waters, the fresh water of the world, are destroyed. Wormwood making a third of the waters bitter and poisonous, the vial turning the rest to blood that the unrighteous be given blood to drink for they have shed the blood of the saints and prophets and are worthy to have blood to drink.

The fourth trumpet and the fourth vial are poured out upon the sun, and it is given the angels the power to smite the sun and stars and moon that a 3rd of their light is dimmed, and the heat from the sun scorches the wicked who curse God rather than repent and give Him glory in His wrath.

Note that the vast majority this happens to are damned. Twice-dead. They aren't being punished to bring a saving repentance spirituality, admitting they were wrong and that Christ is Lord won't save their souls. But even as these plagues fall upon them, the Bible says, they will remain stiff-necked and hearts hardened. Defiant in their error. Cleaving to their sin. They deserve everything they get.

Darkness comes from both the fifth trumpet and the fifth vial. Abaddon opens the Pitt and the smoke rises up to blot out the dimmed light of the sun. And the beast, the antichrist who still remains on his throne during this period of wrath, sees his kingdom left in darkness. And they that worship the beast blaspheme the name of God for their pains and sores and repent not.

During the sixth trumpet and the sixth vial, you see the great river Euphrates mentioned for both. The river is dried up with the sixth vial and four angels that had been bound beneath the Euphrates are loosed with the sixth trumpet.

As the 7th trumpet sounds and the 7th vial are poured, we see lightnings, voices, thunderings, an earthquake, and great hail. Hail the size of a talent.

The heavy common talent, used in New Testament times, was 58.9 kg (129 lb 14 oz).

Wew.

teachings.title: Adding Works Crucifies Christ Afresh
teachings.summary: Those who add their own works to Christ's sacrifice deny the Lord that bought them, deny His preserved word, and risk a hardened heart.
teachings.text:
Everyone who claims to be a Christian but denies the truth of the Gospel, adds their own works to their righteousness, refusing to accept that Christ's death was the propitiation for our sin, crucifies Jesus afresh and puts Him to an open shame. They deny the Lord that bought them.

And, inevitably, these same people who are perishing will deny the word of God is perfect. Inspired. Preserved. Casting doubt on the testimony of God the Father and refuse the call of the Son who was lifted up on the cross. And so they have no part of the better testament. And the rebuke of the Holy Spirit is upon them until such a time where their hardened heart is made permanent. In death or reprobation. And they damn themselves.

teachings.title: One Offering Perfected For Ever
teachings.summary: Christ's one offering cleanses the conscience forever, and the conscience marks three states of man: guilty, cleansed, or seared in reprobation.
teachings.text:
Now having established that Jesus Christ, the Son of God seated at the right hand of the Father, is greater than the angels, greater than Moses, Abraham, David, in all ways, better than the Levites and the descendants of Aaron as the High Priest after the order of Melchisedek, Paul continues to show the superiority of Christ to the Mosaic law itself, which is a picture of His glory. That faith in Him that saves and the promises made of God for that faith, a better covenant. A new and better testament.

Better than the commandments which condemn us, transgressions of the law being sin, better than the dead works which cannot save us and Jesus as our redeemer is a better sacrifice than all the sacrifices offered under the law.

The entire epistle is an appeal to the superiority and primacy of Christ Jesus as our Lord, High Priest, advocate, and sole means of the cleansing of our sins, in either dispensation. Man has always been saved by grace through faith in Christ. The blood of bulls and goats never took away sins. It was not possible, the Bible says. No sacrifice other than Christ cleans the conscience. And so those who yearly sought forgiveness by sin offering rather than as a picture of their faith, fruitlessly returned year after year seeking to clean their conscience.

A conscience, or "with knowledge," offended by sin, knowingly transgressing the law, with understanding, can only be made clean with the blood of Christ. The vail only removed by His flesh, offered for us. A better sacrifice, done once and forever. Taking on the sins of the whole world.

Burnt offerings and sacrifice for sin gave God no pleasure, but Jesus doing the will of the Father, to become sin and die for us that all may be called and those that believe be saved, sanctified once and for all in the offering of Jesus Christ's body. In this the LORD delights.

For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

Practical application of this, the implications of this, that we are forgiven of all sin by this perfect sanctification, total remission, forever, is that we be freed from the burden of guilt and the fear of judgment that we may serve the living God.

Faith in Christ is to be born again, our spirit without sin. The Holy Ghost as witness that we can let go of the sins of the past and have full assurance of forgiveness for sins of the flesh going forward. The knowledge that God so loved us, He offered His only begotten Son. The rest that is found in Christ. The true Sabbath.

*This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them; And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.*

*Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin....*

Most of our troubles as man come from the carrying of that burden. The heavy yoke of the conscience. The fear of judgment and death. The pangs of guilt are the Spirit, bringing us reproof of sin that we may understand the need for salvation, and pricked by the hearing of His word, come to understanding and in that knowledge, repent unto faith.

But for some, who taste that heavenly knowledge, partake in the rebuke of the Holy Ghost, reject it. Resenting being judged. Clinging to the trauma, reveling in their sin. And they willfully sin knowing the judgment of God, rejecting Christ and being made reprobate by God. Having their conscience seared as with hot iron.

These are the three spiritual states of man. Unsaved, saved and reprobate. And the underlying condition of fallen man comes in our conscience; be it guilty, cleansed by the blood, or seared by God for our hardened heart.

teachings.title: Worse than thy sister Sodom
teachings.summary: God was more offended by Judah's spiritual whoredom than by Sodom, so His greatest wrath is for apostate churches like Rome and the Orthodox, more than for sodomites.
teachings.text:
In **Ezekiel 16**, as the Lord speaks through the prophet to condemn Judah and put away the children of Israel as His beloved for her fornication, with the promise of her destruction and the new covenant of Christ, we see their sin compared to that of Sodom's, and it is worse for her whoredoms.

Going after strange Gods, murdering their children and offering sacrifice and incense to idols made of men.

If you recall our recent series on Exodus, you may recognize how God describes His decking of the figurative Israel in skins and linens, gold and precious stones, the same as the Tabernacle He had Moses build.

This is a bill of divorcement, and should give the Zionist dispensationalist crowd to repent, but I want to focus on the sin of Sodom compared to the sins laid at the feet of the children of Judah.

*And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters. Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways. As I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters. Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy. And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.*

God, having laid out their sin, and that in their pride they say they aren't as wicked as the Canaanites, or as Sodom, He reminds them they are of the land of Canaan; their father Abraham was an Amorite, and mother Sarah an Hittite. And so they are sisters of Sodom.

And for all the abominations and pride of Sodom, who God rightly saw fit to destroy and kill all those wicked people, God is more offended by His chosen people, His intended bride, and her not only fornicating after strange gods, not only passing the children He blessed them with through the fire, not only taking their riches and the sacrifices that are His and giving them to idols, going after outlandish gods and people, but doing it for free. Out of insatiable self-indulgence. Not as for hire like most harlots, but just to do it.

It is incredibly important that we Christians, and those who call themselves Christian, recognize during this month of "pride" and filthy reprobates being rebuked for their unnatural lusts, to remember that while God hates f@gs, and has them fit for destruction, His real wrath is kindled in our own apostasy, our own whoredoms. Our own fornication.

God hates the great whore, the Roman Catholic Church, the Orthodox Church, and other harlot daughters, *more* than Sodom.

Unfaithfulness of those claiming to be His intended is more wicked than the filth of Sodom. And the wrath against them will be as it were against Israel, against Judah. Against Sodom and Gomorrah, and worse.

teachings.title: All Israel saved in Christ
teachings.summary: Unbelieving Jews were made reprobate like Pharaoh while a believing remnant remains, since all God's promises are kept in Christ the one seed.
teachings.text:
And so, as Paul in the Spirit testifies, he wishes that his brothers after the flesh would come to the faith. But they are cut off. Just as Esau become Edom, and they were made desolate, Jews were cut off and consumed.

Is God's judgment unrighteous? No. Is His word unfaithful? Again no, for a remnant remains, those saved by faith as is Paul, and to believing Jews whom he writes to in Rome. But the unbelieving Jew, hearts hardened, had their chance, and their destruction served to show the glory of God.

*For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.*

Just as Pharaoh was made reprobate, so too are the Jews after the flesh.

God's promises were kept in Christ. The remnant is in Christ. All Israel was saved, in Christ. The Kingdom, the land that was promised, is through Christ. The blessings were to the seed, and that seed is singular; Christ.

teachings.title: A remnant according to the election of grace
teachings.summary: Romans 11 does not make unbelieving Jews God's chosen; only a remnant elected by grace through faith is saved while the rest are blinded.
teachings.text:
And so, Paul having settled the matter regarding Israel after the flesh, that none are saved without faith in Christ, same as the Gentiles, dead under sin just as the Gentiles are, that any zeal they show towards God, without faith, is out of ignorance and going about to establish their own righteousness, all together vain; He continues stating his fervent desire that his brothers after the flesh repent, and be saved.

This chapter is abused into teaching a false doctrine that all Jews, even the modern "Jews" (who say they are Jews but do lie), are still God's chosen people and thus still are going to be saved, despite being apostate and denying Christ Jesus. They will derisively dismiss the idea that non-believing Jews are cut off and cast out, ears dulled and hearts waxen, unable to believe, as "Replacement Theology."

But the epistle to the Romans demonstrates with finality that all who don't believe are cut off, and that it is one continuation of faith that saves. The same for Jew and Greek. It isn't replacement it is continual, in the election of grace.

Old Testament Israel and New Testament Israel. Hebrew of Gentiles, all were saved by faith. The offer to the Greek came after Christ was lifted up, but it is the same offer. The same gift of eternal life in Christ through faith. Being chosen to be God's people by our belief, not by seed. Wild olive branches grafted in to the root that is found in Israel, as unbelieving Jews are cut off and burned.

Paul begins the chapter giving a rhetorical question to the conclusions he reached regarding apostate Jews in the previous chapters. *Hath God cast away his people? God forbid.* Why? Because he himself is of the Jews and a believer. So were most of the early churches. The remnant of those elect in grace, predestined in Christ (not as Calvanism teaches, but by our faith through Christ, not the other way around). If he, Paul is saved then not all of Israel is cast away. God hath not cast away his people who he foreknew. Again, those that are saved and in whom He works to make vessels fitted to His use. It is the same foreknowledge of the elect, those that would believe, not saying every Jew.

The prophet Elijah cursing Israel for their unbelief, saying "Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life," is reminded by God that He has a remnant of believers still. As wicked and apostate as Israel got, there were still 7,000 who had not bowed the knee to Baal. Paul using this to say that even then, there were Jews who believed and got saved. That all of them were not cast out.

*Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.*

The remnant is according to what? The election of grace. Which is as he already established, being saved by faith calling upon the name of the Lord. This is a conditional statement. Dispensationalism always ignores conditional statements regarding the Jews to make these things apply to all of them.

And, as an aside he makes yet another statement of salvation by faith and not of works;
*And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then it is no more grace: otherwise work is no more work*.

There is no grace if you worked for it. There is no working for it if it is of grace.

What then? If only a remnant remains of those who believed, then Israel as a nation has not obtained righteousness (they seek to establish their own), but the election in grace, believers, have obtained righteousness by faith.

And the rest were blinded. Which brings us back to chapter 1 and the reprobate doctrine. God chooses to blind those who will not believe, giving them up and giving them over.

*According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear*.

As Jesus said in **Matthew 13**, eyes closed, dull of hearing, hearts waxed gross, they cannot hear the word of God and believe.

teachings.title: By their fruits: works-based false prophets
teachings.summary: By their fruits ye shall know them is about false prophets, whose works-based gospel produces insecure, legalistic, hypocritical followers.
teachings.text:
Ultimately, works-based false religion is about pride, and those who push this evil rely on that pride as a way to snare the unsuspecting into their false religion, and away from the truth of God.

It allows them to teach as commandments traditions of men. It allows them to dictate others' "salvation," by letting them set the standard one must reach. It is the root of every false religion.

And you can judge them by their fruit.

**Matthew 7:15-20**
*Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.*
*Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles? Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.*

This is the context of "by their fruits ye shall know them." It isn't about judging someone's salvation, but judging a false prophet. The fruit are those acolytes they gather to themselves.

Works-based "repent of your sins" false prophets create proselytes unsure of their salvation, constantly looking for measures and signs that they are, rather than faith in trusting God's word. And because we all fall short of the glory of God, they begin to be legalistic and holier than thou, seeking to make another man's behavior the mark they have to be better than, that they may look down upon them. It creates hypocrisy and respect of persons. They produce thorns and thistles. Not fruit meet for repentance.

teachings.title: The good and evil figs
teachings.summary: The good figs carried captive and the rotten figs left show both God's mercy and wrath, and believers planted in Christ cannot be plucked up.
teachings.text:
Short chapter, but powerful. The Lord shows Jeremiah two baskets of figs. One very good, the other evil and inedible, and He tells the prophet that the very good figs are the remnant that was carried away in captivity to Nebuchadnezzar. He promised that the tribulation of this is to turn their heart towards God, and they will be returned to Jerusalem filled with zeal.

But the rotten figs represent the wicked of Judah, who will be scattered and bred out of existence, killed by the sword or by pestilence. To be a proverb and a byword for other nations, "see how they have fallen."

Both the saved remnant and the reprobates reveal the glory of God. In His mercy and deliverance from the worst of conditions, to a restored Jerusalem and His wrath against the ungodly who hold the truth in unrighteousness.

The same holds true today.

As **Romans 1:16-20** lays out;

 *For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek. For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.*

*For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness; Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them. For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse*

This prophecy having dual fulfilment; that the Babylonian captivity will end, and some of Judah will be returned by the mercy and grace of God, and *they shall return unto Me with their whole heart*, and that the same will be true of those saved by faith in Christ after the resurrection.

*I will plant them, and not pluck them up. And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God*.

**Hebrews 10:16-26**
*This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them; And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.*

We are planted in Christ and cannot be plucked up. We are His people. A nation that was no nation. And He is our God.

teachings.title: Broken off for unbelief, grafted in by faith
teachings.summary: The unbelieving Jews are cast off and blinded, and are grafted in again only if they believe, while Gentiles who grow highminded can be cut off just the same.
teachings.text:
*For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?*

This is the entire point of Paul's arguments about the Jews. They are cast off. They are blinded. They are reprobate, just as Jeremiah preached against Israel;

*Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the Lord hath rejected them.*

But wouldn't it be wonderful if the veil were lifted that they may come to believe on Christ?

Now the dispensationalist will say that in the end, on the day of redemption, they will look up and see Jesus coming in the clouds and believe and be saved. But that is taught nowhere in scripture.

Paul gives us the actual means by which *some may be saved*. Provoked to jealousy. Provoked to emulation. By what? The mercy and grace shown believers by God. By His glory revealed in the believing Gentiles. The people who were not a people.

This theme runs throughout the epistle. There is no glory but God's. And this is how it is revealed. Mercy and wrath.

It is not up to us to ask why some are fitted to mercy and others to wrath.

This isn't God picking and choosing, but providing the means of salvation, and foreknowledge of who would avail themselves, all elect in Christ Jesus. All who are predestinated by faith in Him to be conformed to Him and His likeness. All who believe become elect and because God predestinated all who believe to be elect and adoption and promises and blessings and to be the seed of Abraham, the father of faith, whether Jew or Gentile. It's the process that was put in place, by the lamb slain before the foundation of the world.

And so knowing this, and having shown the Gentiles of the sorry state of the fallen Jews, Paul warns against thinking Gentiles are some kind of special boys, falling victim to their own conceits the way the Jews have.

*Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.*

If generations of Christians began taking for granted the grace given to them, and assuming it is because they are better than the unregenerate Jews in terms of their own righteousness, they too could be cut off. Blinded just the same.

Some take Paul's caution to the Gentiles to mean something entirely different, that the Jews are saved by some other means. But we have systematically proved by going through Romans that that isn't the case.

Some will say the holy root are the Jews, and that while some branches are cut off and others grafted in, they still are the chosen of God by genetics.

But the true vine is Jesus. It is entirely by grace. There is no difference.

*If they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.*

Simple as.

All this is to encourage mercy for their enemies for the Gospels sake, that Christians can maybe convert some by believing on Christ. That some of the Judaizers might get saved.

*For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy. For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.*

Israel was to be a light unto the unbelieving world. Now the believing world is to be a light to unbelieving Jews. All to God's glory.

*O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out! For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?*
*Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again? For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.*

teachings.title: The land given by the election of grace
teachings.summary: Israel's inheritance was always conditional and by God's election of grace, and Numbers shows He casts off any branches into the fire.
teachings.text:
I will say that while the gift of the promised land was given as an inheritance to those children of Israel, by tribe and by lot, this inheritance was always not only conditional, but by the election of grace, given of God.

God elected that they would receive this land, by covenant of their keeping Him as their God, which they failed to do, the fault being with the people.

The Bible is a book of winnowing, narrowing down and casting off. Of God choosing to bless the lesser. The younger. Not by law or entitlement, but by His purpose and need. Inheritance, but with caveats to His purpose. A continuous replacement. If the study of **Numbers** has taught us anything, God has no problem casting off into the fire any branches He wishes. Reprobation in the Wilderness meant not only being damned, but destroyed in the most painful awful ways. Plague and fire and being swallowed up by the ground itself.

teachings.title: Faith healers are reprobate
teachings.summary: God still heals through prayer, but faith healers who fake miracles for money blaspheme the Holy Ghost and bring a bad report on God's power.
teachings.text:
The working of miracles, particularly healing, is another. God works through the fervent and effectual prayer of believers, often to heal the sick or bring about a miraculous outcome to a seemingly desperate situation.

In the case of the Apostles, those who had seen Christ risen, and been gifted accordingly to perform signs and wonders, the laying on of hands and the responsibility of growing the early church, the gift of healing was more than the hope of faith, but the power itself. And to those that were given it, like those around Samaria that Simon witnessed, worked miracles that the power of the gospel be made manifest, before the sealing of scripture.

And so, the evidence of miracles in our lives, or those that we are told about by others, is real. I have witnessed healing and recovery, miraculous events by my own reckoning, impossible becoming possible with the only explanation being the grace of God. Usually subtle. Sometimes not, but hardly ever "flashy." Rarely so definitive that the skeptic could be convinced, but to the believers, it adds to our faith. To some on the fence, it may help convict them in the Spirit.

But for the unscrupulous, those wishing to gain that prominence by the "gifts of the Holy Ghost," healing becomes an opportunity. Taking advantage of the desperate and brokenhearted. Performing flashy "miracles" of "healing," for filthy lucre's sake. To gain power over others with false hope.

I believe that these "faith healers" are all Reprobate. I believe they are blaspheming the holy Spirit when they claim they are performing miracles by His power. I think it is as wicked as those who claim to be mediums, talking to the dead to take advantage of mourning souls.

And it is incredibly easy to fake. Whether by the placebo effect, plants in the audience, the gullibility of the crowd. Those wanting to be part of something miraculous.

And sometimes, it might be through devils.

And when the frauds are exposed, it brings a bad report of the genuine power of God among the heathen. It shakes the faith of some and becomes a stumbling block to others.

teachings.title: Known by their fruits: Pentecostal delusion
teachings.summary: The saved can be corrected by scripture, but Pentecostals and Charismatics double down, hold works salvation and other heresies, and are known by their fruits.
teachings.text:
It is always amazing to me that the strong delusion people are under when they twist a small portion of scripture to serve their heresies, manages to fool others and bring them into the same delusion.

*But the natural man receiveth, not the spiritual  things of God for they are spiritually discerned.* And because they seek after the error of Simon the sorcerer, they don't know the spiritual things of God. They're blinded to them.

In chapter 3, Paul had already chastened the church for being carnal in regards to these gifts; *For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal.* That's the attitude they had was not spiritual, after the manner of God. He calls them children. And not in an endearing way. And understand he's speaking to people who actually possess these gifts. People who are actually saved by the Gospel through faith by grace. How much worse are these that fake it in order to seem spiritual? How much worse are they who, not being saved, not understanding the gospel, having faith in themselves instead of faith in Christ Jesus?

Simon, the sorcerer was saved. He took rebuke when Peter gave it. We see in the second epistle to the Corinthians that they too were corrected by Paul's letter.

One of the signs of a saved person is their ability to be corrected from scripture, by the word of God, because the Spirit that inspired it and the Spirit that indwells us are in harmony, being one. God is not the author of confusion. But you'll find that regardless of what you show them, Pentecostals and Charismatics will refuse to repent of their belief. They will double down. They will accuse you of not being faithful for trying to pop the bubble of their delusion.

And ultimately if you scratch the surface with them at all on doctrine, They will usually admit to some forms of work salvation. Or some odd heresy like oneness/modalism. That baptism is necessary for salvation. And a host of other weird doctrines.

Since these movements are led by wicked people who are often seen grifting the elderly and the desperate, begging for money for fake faith healing, prayer cloths, and assortment of other con jobs, but yet are not bringing anyone to Christ, You can see how Jesus warning that we shall know them by their fruits is so valuable. We can know they are false teachers because of the number of souls they've misled on the basic simple gospel of God.

teachings.title: The evil of sodomites given free reign
teachings.summary: The Gibeah outrage parallels Sodom to show the evil of a nation allowing sodomites free reign, which God's law calls an abomination worthy of death.
teachings.text:
*And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel*...and we know, men did what was right in their own eyes.

**Judges 19** begins another tale of the excesses and depravity that Israel fell into absent a Moses or Joshua. Relying on regional judges to come forth by God to deliver them from the results that came from the abominations they fell into.

This channel has covered the story told in **Judges 19-21** before, because it deals directly with the evil of allowing sodomites free reign in a nation.

The parallel to **Genesis 19** and the story of the destruction of Sodom is meant to drive home the point. Parallelism is God's way of signifying the importance of the message He is conveying.

A mob of baser fellows of the lewd sort, sons of Belial, Sodomites, surround a house in a city they are allowed free reign in, and there demand the master of the house deliver up a stranger, a man, that they may know him. These dogs burn with lust one for another, working that which is unseemly. Men with men, laying together. Abominations.

Worse they seek to force it by violence, in a mob. To a stranger, a sojourner. A Levite, of the priesthood.

None of the law or the things of God mattered to these reprobates, not retaining Him in their minds. Their conscience seared with a hot iron. Being twice-dead, fit to be burned.

**Leviticus 18:22**
*Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.*

**Leviticus 20:13**
*If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.*

**Deuteronomy 23:17**
*There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.*

**Romans 1:29-32**
*being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers, backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents, without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful: who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.*

teachings.title: How long halt ye between two opinions
teachings.summary: Most people avoid deciding, but preaching the gospel forces them to choose eternal life in Christ or rejecting God and being given over to a reprobate mind.
teachings.text:
The great story of Elijah vs the prophets of Baalim, even the prophets of the groves who ate at Queen Jezebel's table.

God sends Elijah back to the Northern Kingdom of Israel after 3 and a half years of drought and famine.

**Luke 4:25**
*But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land*

Ahab, having been searching for Elijah this whole time to get the prophet to undo the curse Israel was under is off searching again for Elijah, and with him his chief steward Obadiah.

They separate, and Elijah comes upon Obadiah who knows him well. Obadiah is a saved believer in the Lord, yet he works for the wicked king and queen.

Elijah tells Obadiah to fetch Ahab and tell him he's returned, and Obadiah fears for his life. He has been, this entire time, hiding his faith, just as he has his the prophets of the Lord in caves to keep them from Jezebel.

Rather than standing up to evil, preaching against Baal and sin, to bring Israel back to the Lord, they've been shut up in caves and Obadiah's paranoia at the possibility of Elijah ghosting him shows the level of fear of man, and not the fear of the Lord he claims to have.

This is similar to the way many Christians today hide their faith and fear tribulation and persecution more than they fear God. God may have used those hundred prophets to bring about revival. But they hid rather than face death.

**Matthew 10:28**
*And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.*

But Elijah assures Obadiah he will speak to the king that day, and when they return Ahab accuses Elijah of being responsible for the famine. Elijah corrects the wicked king, that it is he and his father's sin that brought it about. And Elijah challenged Ahab to being all Israel together and the prophets of Baal, and meet him at Mt Carmel.

There Elijah challenged the people of Israel; *How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him.*

Then, as now, people generally are unwilling to commit to faith. They go along to get along and put off the choice of salvation or damnation if they can, usually to their own destruction.

The purpose of the word of the Lord is to bring people the choice and force them to decide; do they want to accept the truth? Eternal life in Christ Jesus, admitting they are sinners deserving death and taking the gracious gift of God? Or do they want to reject God and be given up, and given over. Twice-dead.

There are saved people in the world. There are slightly fewer reprobates (although that number seems to be growing). There is a vast majority of those who are caught between, often and in indecision. Soul-winning, giving the gospel to the unbelievers forces them to make this choice. And many receive it gladly. But others, it's the final straw before they decide they do not wish to retain God in their knowledge. And it's too late, reprobate.

Elijah is putting this same decision in the hands of the people.

And as a sign, Elijah calls for two pyres to be set up, two altars, with bullocks upon each as sacrifice. He challenges the 450 priests of Baal to call down fire from their god, to burn up the sacrifice.

And these priests called and called and danced and prayed and from morning until noon cried out 'O Baal, hear us!' But there was, of course, no answer.

teachings.title: Revival forces men to choose life or death
teachings.summary: Preaching and soul winning force people to choose life or death; some are saved, many harden themselves, and our job is to work the harvest and force the issue.
teachings.text:
The nature of revival, of proclaiming the truth of God to all men, to soul-winning and contending for the faith, and challenging false ways and compromise, is that it forces people to choose.

We often talk of God's constant winnowing, the separation of the wheat from the chaff, which is shown throughout the Bible, but the truth is, God is constantly giving men a choice. He is offering us the truth and life, and placing the choice on our hearts.

**Deuteronomy 30:15-20**
*See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil; In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it. But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them. I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
